findings.observation: Used vision tool to examine Sheets 14 and 15 (Dimensional Control & Site Plan 1 and 2 of 2). Two driveways are shown: one on Collier Street (north) and one on South Lamar Boulevard (southeast). Driveway widths are dimensioned (24' and 26'). However, no spacing dimensions are shown indicating the distance from either driveway to the nearest street intersection (e.g., Collier/S Lamar intersection or S Lamar/Evergreen Avenue intersection) or to adjacent property lines. The vision tool confirmed: 'The plan does not clearly show driveway spacing dimensions. There are no explicitly labeled distance measurements indicating the spacing between the driveways and the nearest street intersections.'
findings.reasoning: The CC Submittal Checklist p.5 and Requirements page require that driveway spacing dimensions be shown on plans. Spacing dimensions typically measure the distance from a driveway to an intersection or from one driveway to another on the same property. While the driveways themselves are located on the plan and their widths are dimensioned, the critical spacing measurements that allow TPW staff to evaluate compliance with Transportation Criteria Manual Section 5 driveway spacing requirements are missing.
findings.explanation: Driveway spacing dimensions (distances to intersections or between driveways) not shown on Sheets 14-15
findings.resolution: Add driveway spacing dimensions on site plan showing distances from proposed driveways to nearest intersections (Collier/S Lamar and S Lamar/Evergreen Avenue) and between the two proposed driveways.

findings.observation: Used vision tool to examine Sheet 13 (Overall Site & Paving & Striping Plan) and Sheets 14-15. While the plans show adjacent property boundaries, subdivision names, and zoning information for neighboring properties along S Lamar Blvd, Collier Street, and Evergreen Avenue, no driveways are depicted on these adjacent properties. Vision analysis confirmed: 'There are no driveways shown on the neighboring properties... it does not draw or indicate their specific vehicular access points or driveways.' The curb lines on adjacent property frontages are drawn as continuous without driveway cuts. Property boundaries are clearly shown and would allow measurement of 300-foot distances, but the driveways themselves on those properties are not depicted.
findings.reasoning: The CC Submittal Checklist p.5 and Requirements page require that adjacent driveways within 300 feet be shown on plans. This allows TPW staff to evaluate driveway spacing compliance with neighboring properties. The Transportation Criteria Manual has requirements for minimum spacing between driveways on adjacent properties. Without showing these adjacent driveways, staff cannot verify compliance. The validation methodology notes that when identifying adjacent driveways, one should 'look for two wide, flat-bottomed U-shapes or J-shapes side by side with a gap between them' — no such features are present on adjacent parcels on this plan.
findings.explanation: Adjacent driveways on neighboring properties within 300 feet not shown on Sheets 13-15
findings.resolution: Show all driveways on adjacent properties within 300 feet of the site on the site plan, including properties along S Lamar Blvd, Collier Street, and Evergreen Avenue.

Without showing the opposing driveways across S Lamar Blvd, it is impossible to dimension the required offsets. This is a completeness issue — the plans must show opposing driveways so that offset compliance can be evaluated.
findings.explanation: Site fronts undivided S Lamar Blvd (5U); opposing driveways not shown, so offsets cannot be dimensioned on Sheets 14-15
findings.resolution: Show driveways on properties across S Lamar Blvd and dimension the offsets from the proposed S Lamar driveway to opposing driveways on the undivided street frontage.
